item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #MINPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #MINPRSD
Issued at 06:00 PM 29 August 2026

Light to Moderate to Occasionally Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #AgusanDelSur(SanLuis, Esperanza, LaPaz), #Bukidnon(Lantapan, Baungon, Libona, Malitbog, Talakag), #AgusanDelNorte(Kitcharao, Jabonga), #SurigaoDelNorte(Mainit and Alegria) within the next 1-2 hours.

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are being experienced in #Bukidnon(ImpasugOng, Sumilao, CityOfMalaybalay and ManoloFortich) which may persist within 1-2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
